item.title: Confessional 1.28.0
item.description:
• Screenshots when there's no call window: the call bar says so and one click captures the video's window (YouTube, a player…) or the whole screen
  • Live captions start on their own once the speech model has downloaded on a new Mac
  • Studio finds laughs in shows with a studio audience

item.title: Confessional 1.27.0
item.description:
• Your confessional stays yours: by default only a model on this Mac reads it (Settings → Privacy), and it's offered only after real calls
  • Home starts with what needs you: your own open action items, ticked off right there
  • As simple or as deep as you like: basic settings by default for new users, “Show all settings” for everything, and choose what's in the sidebar
  • Clearer record bar, Highlights gallery, a topics chart from the first week, and an example in empty chats

item.title: Confessional 1.26.0
item.description:
• Records on Macs without a microphone (Mac Studio, Mac mini): Start Recording now records the call audio and screenshots instead of hanging and crashing; plug in a mic during the call and it's added
  • Use Hermes, Pi or another agent harness (Settings → AI Models → Agent harness): chats stay one conversation in the agent, which compacts long ones itself, and it can look things up in your meetings with Confessional's tools

item.title: Confessional 1.25.0
item.description:
• Screenshots follow the conversation: with live captions on, when someone talks about the screen ("as you can see on this slide"), the picture they mean is kept, even a small change like a highlighted cell
  • Fewer repeats, more of what changed: the same slide shown again isn't kept twice, a new page of a mostly white slide or sheet is no longer missed, and (with the images add-on) pictures of just faces are skipped

item.title: Confessional 1.24.0
item.description:
• You've talked about this before: related moments in each meeting, in calendar briefs, and live in the call bar.
  • Notices when a later meeting settles an action item or open question, and suggests ticking it.
  • Smarter screenshots with the images and sounds add-on: search by what's on them, repeats and faces set aside, laughs found in Studio.
  • Chapters follow topic changes; meetings that clearly belong to a project are filed instantly.

item.title: Confessional 1.23.0
item.description:
• Search by meaning: Ask, chat and the meetings search also find what was meant, not just the words. Runs on your Mac.
  • Choose Claude's model and thinking level (Settings → AI Models).
  • Record on iPhone or Apple Watch: new Voice Memos become meetings (Settings → Watch Folders).
  • Share a meeting as a web page, and send summaries to Zapier, Make or n8n with a webhook.

item.title: Confessional 1.22.0
item.description:
• Suggest people: on a project's People tab, the AI reads the project's meetings and suggests who belongs there, and which unnamed speakers are who (one click names them).
  • Someone introduced and called by name who answers is now named, even if they also mention someone else with the same name.

item.title: Confessional 1.21.0
item.description:
• Your meetings in Obsidian: a note per meeting in your vault, with date, people, project and length as properties, the summary, decisions, action items as tasks, and the transcript folded away. Settings → Obsidian.
  • Tick an action item in Obsidian and it's ticked in Confessional too, and the other way round. What you write below the line in a note is kept.

item.title: Confessional 1.20.0
item.description:
• Projects have a People tab: their regulars, people who keep turning up, and unnamed voices that sound like a regular.
  • Merge two names for the same person and they're one person in every transcript, action item and voice memory (undoable). Rename someone once and it changes everywhere.
  • Better at naming a project's regulars and invitees; someone who says Benjamin isn't taken for Benjamin.

item.title: Confessional 1.19.0
item.description:
• Meetings in Spotlight: search a meeting's title, people, project or words from its summary and action items, and open it from there (Settings → Shortcuts & Spotlight).
  • Control Confessional from Shortcuts: start/stop recording, star, add a note, ask your meetings, and read back your last meeting's summary or open action items. Confessional's own Shortcuts actions and Siri phrases come in an update.
